tests.name: Dedicated sample has a fixed measurement host, clipped frost and independent non-intercepting light layers

Real pointer grid and continuous motion stay within a four-degree total tilt
Pointer exit resets gradually, monotonically and finally returns to zero
Inner action receives clicks during tilt and stays keyboard operable
Reduced motion disables hover decoration without hiding the real action
Solid transparency fallback and forced colors preserve readable, operable content
Touch and coarse pointer need no hover and do not activate tilt
Dedicated card works in both languages at 390, 768 and 1440 pixels without overflow
No console or resource failures during pointer and preference tests

limitations: Screenshots and pointer motion use the real controller. Layer-pixel isolation only removes the face transform and hides the other light layer to prevent geometric changes from being mistaken for light.
The isolation checks do not add glow, alter material colors, or change the pointer-generated variables.
Coarse pointer and accessibility preferences are browser emulation, not physical-device or operating-system certification.
Pixel checks quantify this sample scene and do not establish full accessibility or general performance compliance.
